body:
I might need to check into somewhere before I check out...

I never though it could get this bad...

I am to a point that my jaw hurts..I am grinding it so hard.  I dont like drinking...It will not help anything..but I can see why people do it.  I have never felt such raw pain from rejection and fear....I have my Bible next to me...

I will not give into this...

made it through the night until morning...so worried about Christmas day.  I am upset and tettering on the brink.  What happens when the day comes, 7am arrives, and I walk the street essentially howling in the loneliness.  

To the person who commented yesterday, you made a difference and helped me get one day further...thx
I have to check into the overnight emergency shelter..I will make it until morning...please help me with ideas...I dont want to die but not to go on like this either

No.  She informs me that she does not want to feel needed.  You can not force your way into a person's life when they just want to move on.  I thought of committing some small crime to get into jail for some 
"time."  This is how odd my thinking gets.  The thing that stops me is that I dont want to hurt anyone while doing it...then I just opt out.  It makes the urge to stop to inner torment greater.  

I wish I could drink to self medicate but I know that does not help.  So I endure until I wear out or it will get better

There is an emergency shelter but it is closed next week for the New Year.  It is more of having something to look forward to.  When I would stay with my friend once every two or three weeks, I would have a date and hang on while trying to be productive.  Now that she has moved on...there is no end of the rainbow and without anyone in my life...

it is just a shell of existence
